claim: Patchline ships a successor-architecture proof that the next hazard frontier is reachable without a rewrite. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the without a rewrite claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make successor-architecture-proof-gate`.
